symbols.inputTypes: name: Identifier; initialValue: Expression resolving to NUM, TXT, BOOL, or LIST; NULL is not a valid inferred binding type.
symbols.outputType: NONE; declares a named mutable binding.
symbols.preconditions: The name must not already be declared in the current scope. Function-local declarations may not shadow module-level names, matching QX V1 scope rules. The initialValue must be a valid, initialized expression.
symbols.validationRules: Infer the binding type from initialValue. Preserve that type for the binding lifetime. Reject NULL and unsupported types. Module-scope DATA is global; DATA inside a function is local to that function.
symbols.relations: STORE may update DATA bindings subject to scope rules. FETCH may read initialized DATA bindings. VALUE is a separate immutable binding kind.
symbols.astEffect: Declare a mutable symbol with inferred type and initialized state in the current scope.
symbols.possibleErrors: Duplicate declaration; forbidden local shadowing; unsupported initial type; invalid or uninitialized initializer.

symbols.inputTypes: target: Identifier resolving to an existing mutable DATA or COLLECTION binding; value: Expression whose inferred type exactly matches the target type.
symbols.preconditions: Target must already exist, be initialized, and be mutable. VALUE and RECORD bindings are not assignable. A function may update only bindings local to that function; module-level bindings may be updated only at module scope. No implicit global mutation from a function.
symbols.validationRules: Resolve target lexically. Reject undeclared targets, immutable targets, unsupported target kinds, and type mismatches. Do not create a binding when the target is absent.
symbols.relations: Updates DATA or COLLECTION; cannot update VALUE or immutable RECORD. FETCH observes the current value after a successful STORE.
symbols.astEffect: Update the existing mutable binding's value while preserving its inferred type.
symbols.possibleErrors: Undeclared target; immutable target; invalid scope write; type mismatch.

symbols.inputTypes: name: Identifier; value: Expression resolving to NUM, TXT, BOOL, or LIST; NULL is not a valid inferred binding type.
symbols.outputType: NONE; declares a named immutable binding.
symbols.preconditions: The name must not already be declared in the current scope. Function-local declarations may not shadow module-level names, matching QX V1 scope rules. The value expression must be valid and initialized.
symbols.validationRules: Infer the binding type from value. The binding cannot be reassigned after declaration. This immutability applies to the binding; nested LIST value semantics remain governed by the existing QX LIST contract.
symbols.relations: FETCH may read VALUE. STORE must reject VALUE as an immutable target. DATA remains the mutable declaration counterpart.
symbols.astEffect: Declare an immutable symbol with inferred type and initialized state in the current scope.
symbols.qirLowering: QIR 1.5: DECLARE mutable=false followed by exactly one initialization STORE; validator rejects missing, duplicate, or out-of-order immutable declarations and repeated writes.
symbols.vmRequirements: VM tracks immutable declaration and initialization state; permits one initialization after DECLARE and rejects repeated DECLARE or subsequent writes.
symbols.backendRequirements: Web runtime tracks immutable declaration and initialization state; permits one initialization after DECLARE and rejects repeated DECLARE or subsequent writes.
symbols.possibleErrors: Duplicate declaration; forbidden local shadowing; unsupported value type; invalid initializer; attempted reassignment.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.shape: Object literal with named Identifier keys and Expression values; nested RecordLiteral and ListLiteral values are allowed

symbols.inputTypes: name: Identifier; fields: RecordLiteral. Each field key is a unique Identifier and each field value is a non-NULL supported QX value (NUM, TXT, BOOL, LIST, or RECORD).
symbols.outputType: Generic RECORD value type in QIR 1.6; all records share the same base type and no structural schema-specific type compatibility is enforced in this version.
symbols.preconditions: The name must be unique in the current scope. Record field names must be unique. Field values must be non-NULL supported QX values. RECORD declarations are immutable.
symbols.validationRules: Reject duplicate field names, NULL/invalid field values, duplicate binding names, and any attempt to reassign the RECORD binding. RECORD values are distinct from LIST and are never coerced into lists. FETCH may read the whole RECORD value. Field selection and field mutation are not defined in this implementation. All RECORD values share the generic RECORD type in QX V1.6; field-shape-specific type compatibility is not enforced.
symbols.relations: FETCH reads the complete RECORD value. RECORD bindings are immutable; STORE cannot reassign them. Records may be passed to and returned from functions. Field selection and field mutation remain unspecified.
symbols.astEffect: GeometricStatement RECORD contains a RecordLiteral expression with ordered named fields. The generic geometric AST node is preserved; no specialized semantic AST node is introduced.
symbols.qirLowering: QIR 1.6: MAKE_RECORD(fields: [{name, value: ValueId}, ...]) produces RECORD, followed by DECLARE mutable=false and exactly one STORE for binding initialization. QIR 1.5 and earlier reject RECORD type and MAKE_RECORD.
symbols.vmRequirements: VM executes MAKE_RECORD with unique named fields, deep-clones nested record/list values, applies a 10,000-field limit, and enforces immutable binding initialization/write-once behavior.
symbols.backendRequirements: Web Runtime executes MAKE_RECORD with unique named fields, deep-clones nested record/list values, applies a 10,000-field limit, and enforces immutable binding initialization/write-once behavior.
symbols.possibleErrors: QX3028 for duplicate fields, NULL/unsupported field values, invalid RECORD usage, and attempted binding mutation; QIR_E_RECORD_SCHEMA/QIR_E_RECORD_FIELD for invalid QIR record descriptors; QX_VM_RECORD_FIELD_LIMIT for runtime field-limit violations.
requiredTests: Lexer colon token and source locations
Parser named-field and nested RecordLiteral syntax, trailing comma, malformed field syntax
semantic acceptance, duplicate fields, NULL values, duplicate binding, immutable binding, and FETCH
QIR 1.6 MAKE_RECORD lowering, schema validation, serialization, and rejection in QIR 1.5
VM execution, nested values, FETCH, and field limits
Web browser runtime execution and safe JSON text rendering

symbols.astEffect: Declare a mutable, initialized LIST binding in the current scope.

implementationNotes:
The six approved Group 1 statement forms are mapped by geometric-ast-adapter.js to their approved specialized AST node types under DefinitionDeclaration. The adapter preserves the original parser AST and all source/syntax fields.,Semantic Analyzer applies a uniform QX3028 guard to specialized geometric statements through their GeometricStatement syntaxType, and to GeometricCallExpression values. This blocks unresolved symbols while their semantic contracts remain UNSPECIFIED; it does not implement their semantic behavior.,The focused Node test file test/geometric-ast-adapter.test.js passed 7/7 on Termux with Node.js v24.22.3 at commit 663cfc76efa216cbdd4c30c0a4ac4cddd2e2c3db. This evidence does not establish a full-suite pass, lexer/parser suite pass, successful QIR lowering, or VM/backend execution.,Owner-approved usage-position decision (2026-11-28): ORIGIN, FORM, CORE, SEED, ROOT, and IDENTITY are valid only in statement position and invalid as expressions. This decision does not specify argument count or types, output, body policy, declaration ordering or relations, or execution semantics. Their semantic contracts remain otherwise UNSPECIFIED and QIR lowering remains blocked.,Follow-up Termux verification reported by the owner on 2026-11-28: node --test test/geometric-ast-adapter.test.js passed 8/8 (0 failed; 620.443307 ms), including the new statement-only Group 1 expression rejection test. The terminal excerpt did not include Node.js version or git HEAD, so neither is asserted here. This remains a focused test-file result, not a full-suite or QIR/VM/backend success.,Follow-up Termux verification reported by the owner on 2026-11-28 for Group 2 usage-position enforcement: node --test test/geometric-ast-adapter.test.js passed 9/9 (0 failed; 759.40573 ms). The two preceding node --check commands for semantic-analyzer.js and geometric-ast-adapter.test.js were chained with && and therefore completed successfully before the test command ran. The supplied terminal excerpt did not include Node.js version or git HEAD, so neither is asserted. This is a focused test-file result, not a full-suite or successful QIR/VM/backend result.,Owner-approved argument-shape decision for Group 2 (2026-11-28): DATA(name: Identifier, initialValue: Expression); STORE(target: Identifier, value: Expression); FETCH(reference: Identifier); VALUE(name: Identifier, value: Expression); RECORD(name: Identifier, fields: Expression); COLLECTION(name: Identifier). All arguments are required and arity is exact. RECORD.fields remains a generic Expression because QX V1 has no approved record-field/map literal shape. This decision does not determine value types, name resolution/existence, mutability, storage scope, persistence, collection element schema, record field semantics, output types, body policy, or QIR lowering; those remain UNSPECIFIED.,Group 2 argument-shape enforcement implementation added on 2026-11-28: semantic-analyzer.js checks exact arity and AST node kinds for DATA, STORE, FETCH, VALUE, RECORD, and COLLECTION. Identifier designator positions are syntax-only and are not name-resolved by this guard; Expression positions are traversed by the existing expression analyzer. This was an intermediate state; see the subsequent semantic implementation note and verification evidence.
2026-11-28: The assistant selected and recorded a conservative Group 2 semantic design at the user's explicit delegation. DATA is mutable; VALUE is immutable; STORE updates only existing mutable DATA/COLLECTION bindings; FETCH reads initialized supported bindings; COLLECTION creates an empty mutable LIST. RECORD remains explicitly deferred because QX V1 has no record literal or RECORD type; it must not be coerced to LIST. These are contract decisions, not implementation claims. Group 2 remains blocked from QIR until symbol-specific analyzer implementation, QIR lowering, runtime support, and tests are completed.,Group 2 semantic analyzer implementation added on 2026-11-28: DATA declares mutable initialized NUM/TXT/BOOL/LIST bindings; STORE updates only existing mutable DATA/COLLECTION bindings with exact type and prohibits implicit module-binding mutation from functions; FETCH resolves supported bindings as typed expressions; COLLECTION declares an initialized mutable LIST. VALUE remains blocked pending immutable QIR/runtime enforcement; RECORD remains deferred. All Group 2 geometric statements reject bodies/alternate branches. This implementation is analyzer-only: no geometric Group 2 QIR lowering, VM execution, or Web Backend support is claimed.

Owner approval and implementation in progress (2026-11-28): RECORD now uses a named-field RecordLiteral `{ field: Expression, ... }`, with unique Identifier keys and non-NULL supported values. RECORD bindings are immutable; FETCH reads the complete record; field selection and field mutation remain unspecified. QIR 1.6 adds RECORD and MAKE_RECORD; VM and Web Runtime implementations and focused regression tests have been added. All new RECORD tests remain pending Termux execution; no test success is claimed here. Earlier statements that RECORD is deferred are historical and superseded by this decision.
